name: my-web-fetch
description: A custom tool that fetches and summarizes web page content for GitHub Copilot.

languageModelTools.name: get_web_content
languageModelTools.userDescription: Fetches a URL, extracts its readable text, and summarizes it.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetches the content of a given URL, extracts the main readable text (stripping HTML tags), and returns a concise summary of the page. Use this tool whenever the user provides a URL and asks for its content, summary, or key points. Input must be a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.

url.description: The full URL of the web page to fetch and summarize (e.g., https://example.com/article).

getWebContent.useVSCodeProxy.description: Use VS Code's http.proxy setting when fetching URLs.

getWebContent.maxContentChars.description: Maximum number of characters to send to the model for summarization.
